name: Dr. Marcus Chen
title: MD, FACC • Interventional Cardiologist
headline: Compassionate Heart Care Powered by Clinical Innovation
bio: Dr. Marcus Chen is a double board-certified Interventional Cardiologist with over 15 years of clinical practice. Having performed 3,200+ procedures, he specializes in complex coronary interventions and preventive cardiology.

items.title: Coronary Angioplasty & Stents
items.desc: Minimally invasive radial artery access restoring critical arterial flow.

items.title: Preventive Cardiology & Lipids
items.desc: Advanced biomarker profiling, calcium scoring, and genetic risk audits.

items.title: Heart Failure & Valve Health
items.desc: Structural valve evaluations, hemodynamic optimization, and medication management.

items.title: Advanced Diagnostic Testing
items.desc: Stress echocardiography, Holter monitoring, and vascular ultrasound.
